task_description: Build a Windows Local Web Control Center for monitoring AIBox devices and network cameras. Consists of a .NET 8 Local Gateway (MQTT receiver, event normalizer, SQLite storage, REST API, SignalR) and a React/TypeScript Local Web Dashboard accessible at http://localhost:8088.

verification.summary: Gateway (.NET 8) builds with 0 warnings 0 errors. Frontend (React/TypeScript) builds successfully with TypeScript compilation and Vite bundling. Build output correctly placed in gateway/src/wwwroot/. Critical bug (response shape mismatch) fixed after semantic review. MQTT robustness improvements applied (ConcurrentDictionary, bounded channels, dedup race condition handling, timestamp filtering fix).
